meta.name: The Other Black Girl
meta.description: Nella, an editorial assistant, is tired of being the only black girl at her company, so she’s excited when Hazel is hired. But as Hazel’s star begins to rise, Nella spirals out and discovers something sinister is going on at the company.

videos.title: They Say I'm Different
videos.overview: Nella meets Hazel, a new coworker at Wagner Books, who may not be exactly what she seems.

videos.title: After the Storm
videos.overview: After the blow up with Colin, Nella has to decide whether or not to apologize, and whether or not she can trust Hazel.

videos.title: I Know a Place
videos.overview: Nella and Hazel try to start over, while Nella digs deeper into the mystery of Kendra Rae Phillips.

videos.title: What About Your Friends
videos.overview: Nella meets Diana Gordon, a famous author and her hero, and Nella invites Hazel over to meet her friends.

videos.title: Don't You Want Me
videos.overview: A leak of Colin’s book causes pandemonium at Wagner, and tensions boil over between Nella and Vera.

videos.title: Fake Smile
videos.overview: As Hazel maneuvers her way deeper into Nella's life, Nella begins to feel overwhelmed by mounting responsibility at work and growing suspicion of Hazel.

videos.title: Caught in the Rapture
videos.overview: Hazel invites Nella and Malaika to her house for a girls' night, but the more of Hazel's life they see, the more uneasy they feel.

videos.title: The End of Love
videos.overview: Nella's worst fears begin to come true as she tries to put all the pieces together before the launch of Diana's new imprint.

videos.title: To Be Young, Gifted and Broke
videos.overview: We learn more about Hazel and exactly what happened in Boston.

videos.title: Down with Disease
videos.overview: Nella faces the ultimate decision and must choose between everything she's worked for and the safety of everyone she loves.
